name: Pattern discovery routing
description: With a complete brief the agent must run pattern discovery before any lead generation.

parts.text: I sell cross-border payment rails. Find me fintech leads in Thailand.

I studied foreign fintech companies that recently entered Thailand and distilled the recurring signals that preceded their entry, with the number of companies each signal was observed in. Shall I now look for companies showing these signals that have not announced anything yet?
Remind me what the patterns were.
The signals I found for foreign fintech entering Thailand were a local leadership hire, a cluster of regional job postings, and a local trademark filing.

state.discovered_patterns:
1. Local leadership hire (4/5 companies, 4-8 months lead time)
2. Regional job postings (3/5 companies, 3-6 months)
3. Trademark filing (2/5 companies, 6-12 months)
